name: ROCK_ST_REST
meaning: idle; no Update case; update mode NORMAL

name: ROCK_ST_FALL
meaning: gravity only; to 0 when on floor and settleMs<=0; update mode ALWAYS

name: ROCK_ST_PUSHED
meaning: being pushed (msg 0xA); on release -> 1 (ground within 50) or 3

name: ROCK_ST_ROLL_OFF
meaning: rolls 200 u/s along pushHeading until floor lost or 2 s -> 1

name: ROCK_ST_ON_SEESAW
meaning: msg 0xB from the seesaw; no push prompt, no crushing

name: ROCK_ST_LAUNCHED
meaning: following the LaunchArc (msg 0xC); ignores horizontal collision

name: ROCK_ST_SMASHED
meaning: hit by a Train (msg 0 from class 0x87); debris anim; returns home after 5 s

name: ROCK_ST_LVL03_CINE
meaning: Lvl-03 cinematic running; ends via msg 0x13 or cinematic inactive
